reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 7 points better, in a game of about 217 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Wizards.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 66 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 192 and 240 total points.

analyst.text: Boston have lost four straight, the first such streak under Joe Mazzulla, all in clutch games, and Derrick White is 3-of-25 from three over his last three. Paul George sat Sunday for rest and is expected back. Washington have won three straight after an 0-8 start, while Anthony Davis plays amid trade interest and no extension. The angle leans Boston bouncing back, but the Wizards' form makes it closer than the records.
